nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
This Workflow works the best to models that uses QWEN, or any derivatives of it, as a CLIP.

Remove the bypass of the node "Text String (Multiline)" if you want to import a JSON to use as reference. Just don't forget to bypass it again when generating the final prompt.

Bellow, a couple attributes to use when composing images.

Storybook Photography (daytime):
* Photo: high-end mirrorless portrait capture
* Aesthetics: whimsical, joyful, emotionally expressive, vibrant, storybook-like, charming
* Lighting: soft overcast daylight, gentle skin glow, natural highlights, shallow depth of field
* Medium: stylized digital photograph

Commercial Lifestyle (daytime):
* Photo: professional outdoor commercial portrait
* Aesthetics: bright, cheerful, wholesome, colorful, optimistic, family-friendly
* Lighting: bright summer daylight, soft natural illumination, healthy skin glow
* Medium: commercial lifestyle photograph

Pixar Realism (open):
* Photo: professional event photography
* Aesthetics: playful, empowering, expressive, character-focused, highly detailed
* Lighting: warm lantern lighting, cinematic bokeh, soft directional illumination
* Medium: stylized CGI character render

Social Media Realism (open):
* Photo: high-resolution smartphone capture
* Aesthetics: authentic, candid, relatable, modern, intimate
* Lighting: natural ambient lighting, soft skin highlights, balanced exposure
* Medium: digital mobile photograph

Cinematic Movie Still (open):
* Photo: full-frame cinema camera capture
* Aesthetics: cinematic, dramatic, immersive, highly detailed, storytelling frame
* Lighting: motivated cinematic lighting, volumetric light, subtle rim lighting, deep shadows
* Medium: digital cinema photography

Luxury Fashion Editorial (open):
* Photo: professional studio fashion photography
* Aesthetics: luxury, elegant, sophisticated, high-end magazine editorial
* Lighting: soft studio lighting, controlled highlights, smooth shadows, beauty lighting
* Medium: commercial fashion photograph

Instagram Influencer Selfie (open):
* Photo: high-resolution smartphone selfie
* Aesthetics: casual, trendy, authentic, lifestyle photography
* Lighting: natural light, soft skin highlights, balanced exposure
* Medium: digital mobile photograph

Horror Scene (night):
* Photo: dark atmospheric cinema capture
* Aesthetics: tense, unsettling, eerie, suspenseful, highly detailed
* Lighting: low-key lighting, deep shadows, subtle practical lights, atmospheric haze
* Medium: cinematic horror photography

Film Noir (dark):
* Photo: classic noir cinema capture
* Aesthetics: moody, mysterious, dramatic, timeless black and white photography
* Lighting: hard contrast lighting, strong shadows, directional light
* Medium: black and white cinematic photograph

Fantasy Concept Art (open):
* Photo: epic fantasy scene visualization
* Aesthetics: majestic, magical, grand scale, highly detailed fantasy artwork
* Lighting: golden magical light, atmospheric fog, glowing accents
* Medium: digital fantasy illustration

Anime Illustration (open):
* Photo: character-focused anime artwork
* Aesthetics: vibrant, expressive, clean linework, polished anime aesthetic
* Lighting: soft anime lighting, colorful highlights, subtle bloom
* Medium: digital anime artwork

Professional Portrait (open):
* Photo: professional full-frame portrait photography
* Aesthetics: refined, realistic, flattering, highly detailed skin texture
* Lighting: soft key light, subtle fill light, natural skin rendering
* Medium: professional portrait photograph

Vintage 1970s Photo (open):
* Photo: 35mm film camera capture
* Aesthetics: nostalgic, authentic, candid, timeless, documentary feel
* Lighting: natural available light, film-like contrast
* Medium: 35mm color film photograph

Surveillance Camera (open):
* Photo: fixed-position surveillance capture
* Aesthetics: utilitarian, unpolished, realistic, documentary evidence
* Lighting: harsh overhead lighting, low dynamic range
* Medium: security camera image
